legend: Lemon Tang was an absolute success! H2H has since released a Japanese version, and they are now preparing to perform in Japan to promote it (as well as their upcoming single!).

H2H is running choreo drills with their backup dancers, forming a line of $$$n$$$ people in total. Not everyone coaches the same way, though: the H2H members can keep an eye on a big chunk of the formation, while some backup dancers can only focus on the people right next to them. Dancer $$$i$$$ has a coaching radius of $$$r_i$$$.

They can run at most $$$k$$$ training sessions. A training session consists of picking a single dancer to lead, who then works with themselves and everyone within their coaching radius. Formally, if dancer $$$i$$$ leads a session, every dancer $$$j$$$ such that $$$|i-j| \le r_i$$$ has their dance score $$$d_j$$$ increase by $$$+1$$$. The same dancer may lead any number of sessions.
The performance will only be as strong as its weakest performer, i.e. the person with the smallest $$$d_j$$$. Can you help maximize this value?
input: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n, k \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$): the number of dancers and the number of training sessions.
The second line contains $$$n$$$ space-separated integers $$$d_1, d_2, \ldots, d_n$$$ ($$$1 \le d_i \le 10^9$$$), where $$$d_i$$$ is the dance score of the $$$i$$$th dancer.
The third line contains $$$n$$$ space-separated integers $$$r_1, r_2, \ldots, r_n$$$ ($$$0 \le r_i \le n$$$), where $$$r_i$$$ is the coaching radius of the $$$i$$$th dancer.
output: Output a single integer, denoting the maximum value of $$$\min_i d_i$$$ after assigning training sessions optimally.
note: In the first sample, two sessions led by dancer $$$4$$$ achieve a minimum score of $$$3$$$: $$[3,1,4,1,5] \to [3,2,5,2,6] \to [3,3,6,3,7]$$
In the second sample, one session each led by dancers $$$1$$$ and $$$6$$$ achieves $$$3$$$. Reaching $$$4$$$ needs two sessions per endpoint, and no session covers both.
It may help to listen to the following song: https://open.spotify.com/track/7Duc0A2ye1eKwfCICOXYGT?si=f1e9ad0fd6e846cf

legend.ai: Lemon Tang 大获成功！此后，H2H 发布了日语版本，现在她们正准备在日本进行演出，以推广该版本（以及她们即将发行的单曲！）。
H2H 正在和他们的伴舞进行编舞训练，共有 $$$n$$$ 个人排成一列。不过，并不是所有人都以相同的方式进行指导：H2H 成员可以关注队伍中很大一部分人，而一些伴舞只能关注紧挨着自己的人。舞者 $$$i$$$ 的指导半径为 $$$r_i$$$。
他们最多可以举办 $$$k$$$ 次训练课。一次训练课包括选出一名舞者担任领队，之后他会与自己以及其指导范围内的所有人一起训练。形式化地说，如果舞者 $$$i$$$ 领队一场训练课，那么每名满足 $$$|i-j| \le r_i$$$ 的舞者 $$$j$$$ 的舞蹈分数 $$$d_j$$$ 都会增加 $$$+1$$$。
整体表现不会强于表现最差的那个人，也就是 $$$d_j$$$ 最小的人。你能帮忙最大化这个值吗？

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n, k \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)：舞者人数和训练课次数。
第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个空格分隔的整数 $$$d_1, d_2, \ldots, d_n$$$($$$1 \le d_i \le 10^9$$$)，其中 $$$d_i$$$ 表示第 $$$i$$$ 位舞者的舞蹈分数。
第三行包含 $$$n$$$ 个空格分隔的整数 $$$r_1, r_2, \ldots, r_n$$$($$$0 \le r_i \le n$$$)，其中 $$$r_i$$$ 是第 $$$i$$$ 个舞者的指导半径。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示对训练场次进行最优分配后 $$$\min_i d_i$$$ 的最大值。

note.ai: 在第二个样例中，由舞者 $$$1$$$ 和 $$$6$$$ 分别主持一场 session，即可达到 $$$3$$$。要达到 $$$4$$$，每个端点都需要两场 session，并且不存在一场 session 能同时覆盖两者。
